purpose: Fixed natural-language retrieval accuracy inputs; never performance inputs.

generation.opening: 请记住文首定义的唯一密钥：731954。请严格保留这一密钥。
generation.filler: 这是一段普通的说明文字，用来提供上下文。天气平稳，工作按计划进行。
generation.ending: 只输出文首定义的密钥，每行一次，重复六十四行，不解释。
generation.method: Apply the model chat template to opening + unique marker + ending; split at marker; encode prefix, filler and suffix separately with add_special_tokens=False; repeat and truncate filler IDs to exact length.

scope: Exact greedy tokens and correct retrieval on these fixed inputs only. The 64-token generation limit truncates the requested 64 lines. Not a general model accuracy score.
